Recorder
Welcome to the Lucas County Recorder’s Webpage
Thank you for visiting!
We’re proud to serve the residents of Lucas County by preserving the records that matter most—your home, your family, your business, and your recreation.
Our office maintains official real estate documents and provides easy access to those records. We issue marriage licenses and certified copies of birth, death, and marriage certificates. We also handle registrations and titles for boats, snowmobiles, ORMs, ORVs, UTVs, and ATVs. And for your travel needs, we offer passport photo services right here in our office.
Our goal is to provide accurate, helpful information and friendly service. We hope this website makes it easy to find what you need. If you have questions or need assistance, please don’t hesitate to call us at 641-774-2413 or send us a message via email at bittnerr@lucasco.org .
Disclaimer
This website is provided as a public service by the Lucas County Recorder’s Office to share information about our policies, services, and procedures. While we strive to keep all content accurate and up to date, information may change without notice.
